r1-dependency-2.summary: Mapped dependencies for payments-api and analyzed all changes in the 7 days prior to INC-08. Identified 20 changes including recent deploys, config changes, infra updates, and feature flag rollouts, notably ledger-service feature flag change chg-9802 at 13:18 UTC.

findings.statement: payments-api directly depends on ledger-service, upi-gateway, fraud-service, redis-cache, and event-bus, and is called by mobile-bff.
upi-gateway depends on npci-switch and partner-bank-api.
A feature flag rollout chg-9802 for ledger.reconciliation_v2 from 10% to 100% occurred on ledger-service at 2026-10-11T13:18:00+00:00.
Routine release chg-9163 for redis-session and chg-9768 for user-db occurred shortly before the incident window at 2026-10-11T12:12:00+00:00 and 12:13:00+00:00 respectively.

open_questions: What specific metrics and logs show during the exact timeframe around 13:20 across payments-api and its dependencies?
Whether the TLS deprecation warnings in payments-api logs are new or pre-existing prior to the incident.

r1-observability-1.summary: payments-api latency p99 spiked from ~380ms to over 3.2s starting at 2026-10-11T13:20:00+00:00, and its error rate increased starting at 13:25:00+00:00. TLS deprecation warnings were logged continuously throughout the entire window starting before the incident.

findings.statement: payments-api p99 latency spiked starting at 2026-10-11T13:20:00+00:00, jumping from a baseline of ~380ms to 3239.85ms.
payments-api error rate increased starting at 2026-10-11T13:25:00+00:00, going from ~0.3% to ~1.2%.
TLS deprecation warnings for 'legacy-psp' have been logged continuously since 12:00:00+00:00, predating the latency spike.
TLS deprecation warnings are coincidental rather than the cause of the latency spike because they started long before the incident onset.

open_questions: What downstream dependency or internal bottleneck caused payments-api latency to spike at 13:20:00+00:00?

r2-observability-1.summary: Retrieved metrics and logs for ledger-service around the rollout of chg-9802 at 13:18 UTC. Discovered an immediate p99 latency spike starting at 13:19 UTC, coinciding with the feature flag rollout, while error rates and CPU/memory metrics remained stable.

findings.statement: Feature flag chg-9802 (ledger.reconciliation_v2 rollout 10% to 100%) occurred at 2026-10-11T13:18:00+00:00, confirmed by log-02040.
Ledger-service latency_p99_ms experienced an anomaly starting at 2026-10-11T13:19:00+00:00, peaking at 3364.94 ms at 13:23:00+00:00.
Ledger-service error_rate_pct, rps, cpu_pct, mem_pct, and pod_restarts showed no anomalies during the incident window.

open_questions: Whether the increased latency in ledger-service directly causes the performance degradation seen in payments-api.

hypotheses.title: Ledger Service Feature Flag Rollout Contention
hypotheses.mechanism: The rollout of the ledger.reconciliation_v2 feature flag from 10% to 100% on ledger-service at 13:18:00+00:00 triggered immediate processing overhead and latency starting at 13:19:00+00:00. Because payments-api depends synchronously on ledger-service, this caused dependent requests to hang, driving up payments-api p99 latency starting at 13:20:00+00:00.

supporting.note: Feature flag change occurred at 13:18 UTC, precisely 2 minutes before the payments-api latency spike onset.
ledger-service p99 latency spiked starting at 13:19:00+00:00, immediately following the rollout.
payments-api p99 latency spiked sharply upward starting exactly at 13:20:00+00:00.
Establishes the synchronous dependency path from payments-api to ledger-service.

contradicting.note: Error rate increased slightly later at 13:25 UTC rather than simultaneously with the 13:20 latency spike.

assumptions: ledger-service experienced internal computational or query overhead under 100% reconciliation_v2 traffic that propagated back to payments-api.

hypotheses.title: UPI Gateway Upstream Degradation
hypotheses.mechanism: Upstream partner bank APIs or NPCI switch experienced transient performance degradation, causing payment intents and timeouts that increased payments-api latency.

supporting.note: Shows warnings and retries calling upi-gateway prior to the incident.
Shows slow request intent logs on payments-api shortly before the onset.

contradicting.note: The observed retries and slow requests occurred at 12:53 and 13:00, which are significantly earlier than the 13:20 onset.
The latency anomaly aligns precisely with ledger-service feature rollout rather than any new upi-gateway signal at 13:20.

assumptions: Unlogged silent timeouts or further degraded performance occurred on upi-gateway around 13:20 without explicit log entries.

hypotheses.reasoning_summary: We established the exact onset of the payments-api p99 latency spike at 2026-10-11T13:20:00+00:00. Addressing the Critic's point on ledger-service health, specialist r2-observability-1 retrieved its metrics and logs, revealing an immediate p99 latency spike on ledger-service starting at 13:19 UTC directly tied to the chg-9802 feature flag rollout. This confirms H1 as the primary root-cause hypothesis, while H2 remains a weaker alternative due to timing mismatches.
